Why TANDA

Banking that feels like it knows the neighborhood

Simple, in your language

Choose English or Español before you sign up. Every essential feature and every support channel works in both.

Fees you can read

Any fee is shown before you act, in plain words. No surprises buried in fine print.

Rooted in community

Inspired by the mercado, the panadería and the corner store. Proudly Latino in spirit, and open to everyone.

Security center

Protection you can understand

TANDA Shield explains unusual activity in plain language before you act. If your phone goes missing, Emergency Lock locks your card and signs out your devices from one place.

  • Assist never moves moneyAnd it will never ask for your password, PIN or one-time code.
  • Trusted Helper, not a co-ownerFamily can guide you but can't move money or approve anything.
  • Fraud reports any hourLock your card and report unauthorized activity, day or night.

What happens next

From waitlist to your first account

  1. Join the waitlist

    Tell us your email, state and preferred language. That's all we ask for.

  2. We finish getting ready

    We open in California and Texas only after our partner bank and regulators approve.

  3. Apply in your language

    You'll get an invitation to apply in English or Spanish, with identity verification through our partner bank.

TANDA is a financial technology company, not a bank.

Banking services will be provided by an FDIC-insured partner bank, to be named. TANDA accounts are not yet available, and nothing on this site is an offer to open an account or an offer of credit. Products, features, fees and benefits described are planned, depend on partner-bank approval and regulatory review, and may change.
